risks_and_failure_modes: The lifecycle is open; treating its current mark as a close would create false PnL.
Both exact eligible events are long-side, so short behavior remains unobserved.
Two lifecycles cannot estimate repeatability, profit factor, regime stability, or portfolio contribution.
The first exact lifecycle lost; selecting a new target, stop, side, or filter from the second path would be post-outcome tuning.
The observer-bound fingerprint must remain distinct from the base config fingerprint because ledger rebinding is identity-relevant.

confidence.basis: Exact derived observer identity, immutable ledger prefix, recorded visible depth, official funding coverage, and unchanged frozen route parameters.

falsifiers: Any recorded evidence hash or byte count changes.
The observer-bound profile cannot be reproduced by deterministic ledger rebinding from the frozen base config.
The eligible decision, entry book, fee, funding, or current mark does not reconcile to the frozen ledger prefix.
A configured stop crossed before the frozen current mark and was omitted.
Later exact both-side lifecycles are positive after costs and largest-winner removal, which would update the rejection.
